title: Week 4 MFPI analysis: Tupelo High School leads the statewide rankings
dek: What moved in the Week 4 Mississippi Football Power Index, computed from verified results through Sep 22.
author: MFPI automated analysis

sources.label: MHSAA official score center (schedules and scores)
Statewide media rankings used for the Media Rank inputs

limitations: Generated from the published snapshot; no games after the cutoff are included.
Media Rank and Media Strength of Schedule contribute 20% of every rating; MFPI's own score-based model contributes 80%.
No player, injury, coaching or game-narrative information is used or implied.

sections.heading: The top of the statewide rankings
paragraphs: [[tupelo]] (4-0) is No. 1 for the 4th straight published week. MFPI rating: increased 3.1 points to 96.2. In the latest window it beat [[oxford]] (currently No. 12) 56-17 at home on Sep 18.
No. 2 [[diberville]] (4-0, 7A): ranking unchanged at No. 2; rating increased 1.7 points to 94.3. It beat [[pascagoula]] (currently No. 73) 24-0 on the road on Sep 18.
No. 3 [[warren-central]] (4-0, 6A): ranking up 1 spot to No. 3 (from No. 4); rating increased 2.9 points to 92.2. It beat [[vicksburg]] (currently No. 85) 45-3 on the road on Sep 18.
No. 4 [[starkville]] (4-0, 7A): ranking down 1 spot to No. 4 (from No. 3); rating decreased 0.4 points to 91.9. It beat [[louisville]] (currently No. 18) 20-16 on the road on Sep 18.
No. 5 [[gulfport]] (2-1, 7A): ranking up 1 spot to No. 5 (from No. 6); rating increased 3.3 points to 90.9. It lost to [[petal]] (currently No. 14) 39-40 on the road on Sep 18.

sections.heading: Classification leaders
paragraphs: Class ranks are the statewide order filtered to one classification; MFPI never recalculates a separate class rating.
Class 5A: [[pontotoc]] replaced [[brookhaven]] at No. 1. Class 2A: [[east-webster]] replaced [[scott-central]] at No. 1.

sections.heading: Results that raised ratings most
paragraphs: The largest rating increases among teams with a verified result in this window. A rating can also move without a game, because every opponent's rating is re-solved each week.
[[simmons]] (+25.6 to 71.9, now No. 42) beat [[port-gibson]] (currently No. 114) 32-6 at home on Sep 18.
[[northeast-jones]] (+14.9 to 43.4, now No. 135) beat [[lawrence-county]] (currently No. 195) 43-14 on the road on Sep 18.
[[callaway]] (+13.7 to 50.2, now No. 112) beat [[terry]] (currently No. 45) 7-6 on the road on Sep 18.
[[lake]] (+13.2 to 53.8, now No. 98) beat [[choctaw-central]] (currently No. 134) 20-14 at home on Sep 18.
[[forest-hill]] (+13.2 to 32.4, now No. 164) lost to [[canton]] (currently No. 47) 19-42 at home on Sep 17.
The full list of movers is in the [[risers-and-fallers:2026-week-04-risers-and-fallers]] analysis.

sections.heading: Schedule strength
paragraphs: MFPI strength of schedule is the average current rating of every completed opponent, expressed as a statewide percentile (100 is the strongest schedule in this week's field, not a perfect grade). The five strongest schedules: [[vicksburg]] (0-4, SOS percentile 100.0); [[oak-grove]] (2-1, SOS percentile 99.5); [[stone]] (1-2, SOS percentile 99.1); [[germantown]] (2-2, SOS percentile 98.6); [[brandon]] (3-1, SOS percentile 98.2).

Teams that have played furthest above their own classification (average class steps up, games up in class): [[okolona]] (1A, +2.67, 3 up); [[poplarville]] (4A, +2.00, 4 up); [[kosciusko]] (4A, +2.00, 4 up); [[calhoun-city]] (1A, +2.00, 4 up); [[velma-jackson]] (2A, +2.00, 4 up).

sections.heading: Data notes and limitations
paragraphs: Snapshot generated September 22, 2026 at 11:19 AM Central with a cutoff of September 22 at 11:00 AM Central, formula MFPI-3.2.
458 of 465 game listings due by the cutoff had verified scores (98.5%); the rest count as unavailable, never as losses or 0-0 results.

[[cleveland-central]] had no linked results in this snapshot because the score feed lists the school under a different name. The link has been confirmed and applies from the next weekly run; until then its rating is provisional and does not reflect its games.

No verified results were linked to [[northside]] for this cutoff. Their ratings are provisional and rest on class, media and neutral inputs; their positions should not be read as the product of games.

[[houston]] is credited with two games on Sep 11 in this snapshot. One of them was played by a same-named out-of-state school; that game is removed from [[houston]]'s record from the next weekly run, which also affects its opponents.
Opponent ranks in this article are the opponent's rank in this snapshot, not its rank on the day the game was played, unless a sentence says otherwise.
